data: Which of the following lines represent a random model with 1300 languages?

The green line represents a random model with 1300 languages. This can be inferred from the caption, which states that the green and red data come from a "Random" model where each "language" is produced by a uniform random distribution of 14 category centroids. Additionally, the caption mentions that the red curve represents an "ideal" statistics of such a model with a very large number of languages, while the green line corresponds to a random model with 1300 languages.
